يفتضخن (form VIII)

# يُفْتَضَخْنَ (yuftaḍaḵna) /juf.ta.dˤax.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
